summary: Verified AiSensy hardcoded fallback fix. Fallback literals for AISENSY_API_KEY and AISENSY_API_KEY_UC in server.py equal .env values (compared without printing). Importing server with both env vars unset and load_dotenv disabled yields non-empty keys equal to .env values. Single homepage hero form submission (QA Test / 9999900031 / Germany) -> POST /api/webhook/lead 200, success UI 'Request received!' + toast shown, backend log: "Routed WhatsApp [website] 'visaxpert_website' to 9999900031: sent". Lead stored with source=homepage, whatsapp.status=sent; then deleted by _id (1 deleted, 0 remaining).
critical_code_review_comments: Live API keys hardcoded in source (per user request) - security risk if repo is public; consider rotating if repo is shared.

Other env-dependent settings (RESEND_API_KEY, GOOGLE_SHEET_WEBHOOK, WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN) still default to '' on Hostinger if .env is not deployed - email/sheet features may silently not work there; also MONGO_URL defaults to localhost.
seed_data_creation: One lead (phone 9999900031) created via UI and deleted by _id afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && env -u AISENSY_API_KEY -u AISENSY_API_KEY_UC python tests/check_aisensy_fallback.py` to re-verify fallback without printing keys. Use only fake phones 99999000xx; AiSensy is live.
